title: Channel
text: Model isotropic free-space or ray-tracing based channel, {Path loss} sets Free-space path loss 10; {Source of channel model} sets the channel source Isotropic, {Antenna gain} sets the gain of transmitter antenna, {Impedance (Ohm)} sets the input impedance of transmitter antenna, {Path delay} sets the free-space path delay, {Map}, {Propagation model}, {Tx site} sets the transmitter site txsite object, {Rx site} sets the receiver site rxsite object, {View Site} displays RF propagation, {Carrier frequencies}, {Simulate noise} sets the simulate thermal noise, {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals, {Edit System} sets the edit or expand channel, {Modeling options} sets the technique to model frequency-dependent channel parameters Time, {Relative error desired (dB)} sets the relative error for the rational fit, {Automatically estimate impulse response duration} sets the automatically calculate impulse response and {Impulse response duration}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Antenna gain
params.values: Gain of transmitter antenna 0 dBi (default) | real scalar or vector | positive scalar or vector

params.name: Impedance (Ohm)
params.values: Input impedance of transmitter antenna 50 (default) | complex scalar or vector

params.name: Path loss
params.values: Free-space path loss 10 dB (default) | real scalar or vector | positive scalar or vector

params.name: Path delay
params.values: Free-space path delay 0 s (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Map
params.values: Map for visualization or surface data "none" (default) | siteviewer object | triangulation object | string scalar | character vector

params.name: Tx site
params.values: Transmitter site txsite object | array of txsite objects

params.name: Carrier frequencies
params.values: Carrier frequencies of channel 2.1 GHz (default) | nonnegative scalar or row vector

params.name: Edit System
params.values: Edit or expand channel block button

params.name: Modeling options
params.values: Technique to model frequency-dependent channel parameters Time domain (default) | Frequency domain

params.name: Relative error desired (dB)
params.values: Relative error for the rational fit -40 (default) | scalar
